COST BREAKDOWN
Attorney fees (statutory)
$18,000–$19,800
Executor commission
$18,000 (statutory)
Court filing + publication
$400–$1,500
CAL. PROB. CODE §10810

California uses a statutory percentage schedule under Cal. Prob. Code §10810 (attorney) and §10800 (executor). Both are entitled to the SAME schedule, so total statutory fees roughly double. The 4-month creditor claim period under §9100 plus urban court backlogs push typical timelines to 12-24 months.

WHAT A LIVING TRUST WOULD HAVE COST
Trust setup cost
$2,025–$6,750
Net probate savings avoided
$29,650–$37,275
Estimates only. Actual probate costs depend on estate composition, court backlog in your county, and creditor claims. Consult a licensed attorney in your state before acting on these numbers.
